notes: Grader-only (HC calling Guess), stdio-adapted through interactor.py with the games in lockstep, so the statement's 1 000 000 games fit the judge budget: Q and the Q values of N, then rounds of one token per unfinished game (a guess G, or -X to answer X) answered by one reply per guess; interactor.py relays the rounds to a C++ judge built like a reference. Every game must use at most W guesses (2^W <= 3N), the full score in all subtasks. No accepted submission exists (the one C++, 5109023, is WA), so orig.cpp follows a public 100-point solution (hoanxuanbach/Competitive-Programming, OI/IOI/2010/hottercolder.cpp), its loop rewritten as a resumable state per game. A simulation of it finds every secret within W guesses for every N <= 3000, for every secret of the 152 values of N within 3 of floor(2^k / 3) up to 3 000 000 and for 1 in 9973 secrets at N = 500 000 000, and in 3 000 000 random games up to N = 500 000 000. --max is the 1 000 000 games at N = 500 000 000.
